claims.text: The FDA ertugliflozin label lists alcohol abuse among precipitating conditions for ketoacidosis.
claims.quote: Precipitating conditions for diabetic ketoacidosis or other ketoacidosis include under-insulinization due to insulin dose reduction or missed insulin doses, acute febrile illness, reduced caloric intake, ketogenic diet, surgery, volume depletion, and alcohol abuse.

headline.text: The FDA ertugliflozin label identifies alcohol abuse as a precipitating condition for ketoacidosis.

reported.text: The label identifies alcohol abuse rather than quantifying the effect of a particular drinking amount.

gaps.text: The packet contains no PubMed abstract evaluating this combination.
searched: (ethanol[tiab] OR alcohol[tiab]) AND "ertugliflozin"[tiab] AND (interaction OR coadministration)
